name: Block Skewed Memory
definition: A memory organization that stores volume data in subcubes (blocks) of $b 	imes b 	imes b$ voxels such that all voxels of a block are stored linearly in the same DRAM page, while maintaining skew at the block granularity to support view-independent rendering.
summary: Block Skewed Memory optimizes volume rendering by storing cubic voxel blocks linearly in DRAM pages, reducing inter-chip communication compared to voxel-level skewing at the cost of on-chip reordering buffers.
